# A tape drive session through the Linux st driver, written by hand from
# Documentation/scsi/st.rst and linux/mtio.h. One line per call made on
# /dev/nst0; the test drives StTransport through the same steps.
#
# Status of a freshly loaded LTO-5 cartridge: online, at BOT, density
# code 0x58 in mt_dsreg's top byte, variable block size (0).
mtget -> type=0x72 gstat=BOT,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=0 blkno=0
mtop MTSETBLK 0 -> ok

# identify(): rewind, read the first block (a VOL1 for TAPE01 in EBCDIC),
# rewind again.
mtop MTREW 1 -> ok
mtop MTSETBLK 0 -> ok
read 262144 -> 80 hex=e5d6d3f1e3c1d7c5f0f1 pad=40
mtop MTREW 1 -> ok

# A label, a file mark, then large blocks into the early warning: the
# first write past it fails with ENOSPC and GMT_EOT is set; the driver
# then takes writes up to the physical end, so the block goes again.
write 80 -> 80
mtop MTWEOF 1 -> ok
write 262144 -> 262144
write 262144 -> ENOSPC
mtget -> gstat=EOT,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=1 blkno=1
write 262144 -> 262144
write 262144 -> 262144
# The physical end: ENOSPC again.
write 262144 -> ENOSPC

# Reading back: a block returns its length, a file mark reads as 0 bytes
# (GMT_EOF, not GMT_EOD), a block longer than the buffer is ENOMEM.
mtop MTREW 1 -> ok
read 262144 -> 80 pad=40
read 262144 -> 0
mtget -> gstat=EOF,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=1 blkno=0
read 262144 -> ENOMEM

# Spacing past the end of data: EIO with GMT_EOD. Reading there: 0 bytes
# with GMT_EOD.
mtop MTFSF 5 -> EIO
mtget -> gstat=EOD,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=2 blkno=0
read 262144 -> 0
mtget -> gstat=EOD,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=2 blkno=0

# Spacing back past the beginning: EIO with GMT_BOT.
mtop MTBSF 9 -> EIO
mtget -> gstat=BOT,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=0 blkno=0

# Spacing records over a file mark: EIO with GMT_EOF.
mtop MTFSR 3 -> EIO
mtget -> gstat=EOF,ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=1 blkno=0
mtpos -> 3

# A medium error: EIO without GMT_EOD.
read 262144 -> EIO
mtget -> gstat=ONLINE dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=1 blkno=0

# Density by name (*ULTRIUM5 is 0x58), end of data, erase.
mtop MTSETDENSITY 88 -> ok
mtop MTEOM 1 -> ok
mtop MTERASE 1 -> ok

# A write-protected cartridge refuses writes with EROFS.
mtop MTREW 1 -> ok
write 80 -> EROFS
mtget -> type=0x72 gstat=BOT,ONLINE,WR_PROT dsreg=0x58000000 fileno=0 blkno=0

# Unload: offline, the door open, then no medium.
mtop MTOFFL 1 -> ok
mtget -> gstat=DR_OPEN dsreg=0 fileno=-1 blkno=-1
mtop MTREW 1 -> ENOMEDIUM
